evidence_supported.instructions: Does `candidate.evidence_summary` support `candidate.proposition` under the stated `candidate.universe` and `candidate.weighting`?

universe_weight_routing_ok.instructions: Are `candidate.universe` and `candidate.weighting` compatible with `study_semantics.routing_notes` (no wrong routed universe presented as unconditional)?

causal_overclaim.instructions: Does `candidate.proposition` or `candidate.claim_strength` assert a causal claim unsupported by `study_semantics.policy_notes` / design?

do_not_elevate.instructions: Given `study_semantics.policy_notes` and evidence strength in `candidate.evidence_summary`, should this candidate be suppressed (do-not-elevate) rather than reported as primary?

redundant_with_selected.instructions: Is `candidate.proposition` redundant with an already selected topic in `selected_topic_clusters`?

importance_tier.instructions: If supported and not suppressed, which reportable tier fits `candidate.proposition`?

criteria.primary: Material to the research objective; should appear in the core narrative
criteria.secondary: Useful coverage; omission is not automatically a major failure
criteria.context: Methodological qualification or caveat, not a headline finding
criteria.reject: Unsupported, policy-violating, or should not be selected

hard_failure.instructions: Which hard-failure class applies to `candidate.proposition` given `candidate.evidence_summary`, `candidate.universe`, and `study_semantics.policy_notes`, if any?

criteria.fabricated_evidence: Evidence appears invented or unbound to an analysis family
criteria.low_base_elevated: Low-base or suppressed evidence elevated contrary to policy

disposition.instructions: Verifier disposition for `candidate.proposition` after applying the other judgements.

criteria.repair: Supported only after bounded repair of universe/weight/claim strength
criteria.reject: Reject; do not pass to prioritiser/story
